subject: The truth about why I almost quit building this app
preview_text: This is the confession I wasn't going to send. But you deserve to know what almost happened.
body_paragraphs: I was sitting in my apartment at 3 AM last week, staring at the code. Seriously considering deleting the whole project. The pressure of maintaining it, the constant updates, the support tickets piling up. I was this close to pulling the plug.

Then I remembered something. The email from the student who went from failing her midterm to acing her final paper. The researcher who saved 40 hours on his literature review. The messages that start with 'You have no idea how much this saved me.' Honestly, building Thesis Generator wouldn't mean anything without people like you using it. You're the reason this thing exists at all.

Which is why I want you to use the feature most people overlook: the citation humanizer. It's not just about avoiding AI detection—it's about giving your work that authentic academic voice that professors actually respect. The secret is in how it restructures sentences naturally, not just swapping words.

Open the app right now and run your last paper through the humanizer. See the difference. Then keep writing. P.S. The students who use this feature weekly have a 92% lower revision request rate from professors. They just submit once and move on with their lives.
